entries.description: (Optional) Settings for specific conversion engines. Each key in this dictionary is the internal name of a conversion engine. The associated value is a dictionary containing the settings associated with that conversion engine. If the settings for a particular conversion engine are not found in the dictionary, default settings shall be used.

name: WebCaptureCommandSettingsDictionaryTable395

title: Entries in a box colour information dictionary

entries.name: CropBox
entries.description: (Optional) A box style dictionary (see "Table 397 — Entries in a box style dictionary") specifying the visual characteristics for displaying guidelines for the page’s crop box. This entry shall be ignored if no crop box is defined in the page object.

entries.name: BleedBox
entries.description: (Optional) A box style dictionary (see "Table 397 — Entries in a box style dictionary") specifying the visual characteristics for displaying guidelines for the page’s bleed box. This entry shall be ignored if no bleed box is defined in the page object.

entries.name: TrimBox
entries.description: (Optional) A box style dictionary (see "Table 397 — Entries in a box style dictionary") specifying the visual characteristics for displaying guidelines for the page’s trim box. This entry shall be ignored if no trim box is defined in the page object.

entries.name: ArtBox
entries.description: (Optional) A box style dictionary (see "Table 397 — Entries in a box style dictionary") specifying the visual characteristics for displaying guidelines for the page’s art box. This entry shall be ignored if no art box is defined in the page object.

name: BoxColourInformationDictionaryTable396

title: Entries in a box style dictionary

entries.name: C
entries.description: (Optional) An array of three numbers in the range 0.0 to 1.0, representing the components in the DeviceRGB colour space of the colour that shall be used for displaying the guidelines. Default value: [0.0 0.0 0.0].

entries.name: W
entries.description: (Optional) The guideline width in default user space units. Default value: 1.

entries.name: S
entries.description: (Optional) The guideline style: S (Solid) A solid rectangle. D (Dashed) A dashed rectangle. The dash pattern shall be specified by the D entry. Other guideline styles may be defined in the future. Default value: S.

entries.name: D
entries.description: (Optional) A dash array defining a pattern of dashes and gaps that shall be used in drawing dashed guidelines (guideline style D). The dash array shall be specified in default user space units, in the same format as in the line dash pattern parameter of the graphics state (see 8.4.3.6, "Line dash pattern"). The dash phase shall not be specified and shall be assumed to be 0. EXAMPLE A D entry of [3 2] specifies guidelines drawn with 3-unit dashes alternating with 2-unit gaps. Default value: [3].

name: BoxStyleDictionaryTable397

title: Additional entries specific to a printer’s mark annotation

entries.name: Subtype
entries.description: (Required) The type of annotation that this dictionary describes; shall be PrinterMark for a printer’s mark annotation.

entries.name: MN
entries.description: (Optional) An arbitrary name identifying the type of printer’s mark, such as ColorBar or RegistrationTarget.

name: PrinterMarkAnnotationTable398

title: Additional entries specific to a printer’s mark form dictionary

entries.name: MarkStyle
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.4) A text string representing the printer’s mark in human- readable form and suitable for presentation to the user.

entries.name: Colorants
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 1.4) A dictionary identifying the individual colourants associated with a printer’s mark, such as a colour bar. For each entry in this dictionary, the key is a colourant name and the value is an array defining a Separation colour space for that colourant (see 8.6.6.4, "Separation colour spaces"). The key shall match the colourant name given in that colour space.

name: PrinterMarkFormDictionaryTable399

title: Entries in a separation dictionary

entries.name: Pages
entries.description: (Required) An array of indirect references to page objects representing separations of the same document page. One of the page objects in the array shall be the one with which this separation dictionary is associated, and all of them shall have separation dictionaries (SeparationInfo entries) containing Pages arrays identical to this one.

entries.name: DeviceColorant
entries.description: (Required) The name of the device colourant that shall be used in rendering this separation, such as Cyan or PANTONE 35 CV.

entries.name: ColorSpace
entries.description: (Optional) An array defining a Separation or DeviceN colour space (see 8.6.6.4, "Separation colour spaces" and 8.6.6.5, "DeviceN colour spaces"). It provides additional information about the colour specified by DeviceColorant — in particular, the alternate colour space and tint transformation function that shall be used to represent the colourant as a process colour. This information enables an interactive PDF processor to preview the separation in a colour that approximates the device colourant. The value of DeviceColorant shall match the space’s colourant name (if it is a Separation space) or be one of the space’s colourant names (if it is a DeviceN space).

name: SeparationDictionaryTable400

title: Entries in an output intent dictionary

entries.name: Type
entries.description: (Optional) The type of PDF object that this dictionary describes; if present, shall be OutputIntent for an output intent dictionary.

entries.name: S
entries.description: (Required) The output intent subtype. The value may be GTS_PDFX, GTS_PDFA1, ISO_PDFE1 or a key defined by an ISO 32000 extension.

entries.name: OutputCondition
entries.description: (Optional) A text string concisely identifying the intended output device or production condition in human-readable form. This is the preferred method of defining such a string for presentation to the user.

entries.name: OutputConditionIdentifier
entries.description: (Required) A text string identifying the intended output device or production condition in human- or machine-readable form. If human-readable, this string may be used in lieu of an OutputCondition string for presentation to the user. A typical value for this entry may be the name of a production condition maintained in an industry-standard registry such as the ICC Characterization Data Registry. If the designated condition matches that in effect at production time, the production software is responsible for providing the corresponding ICC profile as defined in the registry. If the intended production condition is not a recognised standard, the value of this entry may be Custom or an application-specific, machine-readable name. The DestOutputProfile entry defines the ICC profile, and the Info entry shall be used for further human- readable identification.

entries.name: RegistryName
entries.description: (Optional) A text string (conventionally a uniform resource identifier, or URI) identifying the registry in which the condition designated by OutputConditionIdentifier is defined.

entries.name: Info
entries.description: (Required if OutputConditionIdentifier does not specify a standard production condition; optional otherwise) A human-readable text string containing additional information or comments about the intended target device or production condition.
entries.qualifier: Required if OutputConditionIdentifier does not specify a standard production condition; optional otherwise

entries.name: DestOutputProfile
entries.description: (Required if OutputConditionIdentifier does not specify a standard production condition; optional otherwise) An ICC profile stream defining the transformation from the PDF document’s source colours to output device colourants. The format of the profile stream is the same as that used in specifying an ICCBased colour space (see 8.6.5.5, "ICCBased colour spaces"). The output transformation uses the profile’s "from CIE" information (BToA in ICC terminology); the "to CIE" (AToB) information may optionally be used to remap source colour values to some other destination colour space, such as for screen preview or hardcopy proofing.
entries.qualifier: Required if OutputConditionIdentifier does not specify a standard production condition; optional otherwise

entries.name: DestOutputProfileRef
entries.description: (Optional; PDF 2.0) A dictionary containing information about one or more referenced ICC profiles. See "Table 402 — Entries in a DestOutputProfileRef dictionary".

entries.name: MixingHints
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) A DeviceN Mixing Hints dictionary ("Table 72 — Entries in a DeviceN mixing hints dictionary") which shall not contain a DotGain key. NOTE 1 This is because dot gain information is better handled according to ISO 17972-4. In addition, each key in the Solidities dictionary referenced from the MixingHints dictionary shall not also be present in the SpectralData dictionary within the same output intent. NOTE 2 This is because it would not be clear which one is to be used, so only allowing one place where such data are present avoids the conflict. This document intentionally does not specify how a PDF processor may make use of the data provided in the MixingHints dictionary, and a PDF processor may ignore such data altogether. EXAMPLE 1 The data in the MixingHints dictionary could be used in the process of rendering or color converting the colourants specified in the Solidities dictionary referenced from the MixingHints dictionary.

entries.name: SpectralData
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) A dictionary where each key represents a colourant name as defined in 8.6.6.4, "Separation colour spaces" and where the value of each key shall be a stream whose contents shall represent CxF/X-4 spot colour characterisation data that conform to ISO 17972-4. This stream shall contain exactly one SpotInkCharacterisation element whose SpotInkName matches the colourant name (see 7.3.5, "Name objects"). In addition, this stream may contain zero or more further SpotInkCharacterisation elements, and/or other data. NOTE 3 This facilitates referencing the same CxF/X-4 data stream from more than one entry in the SpectralData dictionary, as long as for each such entry there is a matching SpotInkCharacterisation entry in the CxF/X-4 data stream. In addition, each key in this dictionary shall not also be present in the Solidities dictionary referenced from the MixingHints dictionary within the same output intent. NOTE 4 This is because it would not be clear which one is to be used, so by only allowing one place where such data are present it avoids the conflict. This document intentionally does not specify how a PDF processor may make use of the data provided in the SpectralData dictionary, and a PDF processor may ignore such data altogether. EXAMPLE 2 The data in the SpectralData dictionary could be used in the process of rendering or colour converting the colourants specified in the SpectralData dictionary.

name: OutputIntentDictionaryTable401

title: Entries in a DestOutputProfileRef dictionary

entries.name: CheckSum
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) An MD5 hash consisting of a 16 byte string that shall be computed as described in "7.11.4, "Embedded file streams" for the uncompressed ICC profile file. NOTE 1 Any MD5 embedded within the ICC profile itself is computed differently and is inappropriate for use as the value of the CheckSum key. NOTE 2 This is strictly a checksum, and is not used for security purposes.

entries.name: ColorantTable
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) An array of colourant names, each of which shall be encoded as a name object. The order and names of the colourants in ColorantTable shall be identical to those in the ICC colorantTableTag in the ICC profile.

entries.name: ICCVersion
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) The value of bytes 8 to 11, ICC profile version number, from the header of the ICC profile.

entries.name: ProfileCS
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) The four-byte colour space signature of the ICC profile, including any space characters.

entries.name: ProfileName
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) The value of the ICC profileDescriptionTag from the ICC profile.

entries.name: URLs
entries.description: (Optional, PDF 2.0) An array, containing at least one element, where each element shall be an embedded file specification (7.11.4, "Embedded file streams") or a URL file specification (7.11.5, "URL specifications"). NOTE: ICC profiles referenced via the URLs array do not have to conform to the ICCBased requirements of "Table 67 — ICC profile types" and thus can also support N- component output profiles.

name: DestOutputProfileRefDictionaryTable402

title: Additional entries specific to a trap network annotation

entries.name: Subtype
entries.description: (Required) The type of annotation that this dictionary describes; shall be TrapNet for a trap network annotation.

entries.name: LastModified
entries.description: (Required if Version and AnnotStates are absent; shall be absent if Version and AnnotStates are present; PDF 1.4) The date and time (see 7.9.4, "Dates") when the trap network was most recently modified.
entries.qualifier: Required if Version and AnnotStates are absent; shall be absent if Version and AnnotStates are present; PDF 1.4

entries.name: Version
entries.description: (Required if AnnotStates is present; shall be absent if LastModified is present) An unordered array of all objects present in the page description at the time the trap networks were generated and that, if changed, could affect the appearance of the page. If present, the array shall include the following objects: • All content streams identified in the page object’s Contents entry (see 7.7.3.3, "Page objects") • All resource objects (other than procedure sets) in the page’s resource dictionary (see 7.8.3, "Resource dictionaries") • All resource objects (other than procedure sets) in the resource dictionaries of any form XObjects on the page (see 8.10, "Form XObjects") • All OPI dictionaries associated with XObjects on the page (see 14.11.7, "Open prepress interface (OPI)"). This entry is deprecated in PDF 2.0.
entries.qualifier: Required if AnnotStates is present; shall be absent if LastModified is present

entries.name: AnnotStates
entries.description: (Required if Version is present; shall be absent if LastModified is present) An array of name objects representing the appearance states (value of the AS entry) for annotations associated with the page. The appearance states shall be listed in the same order as the annotations in the page’s Annots array (see 7.7.3.3, "Page objects"). For an annotation with no AS entry, the corresponding array element should be null. No appearance state shall be included for the trap network annotation itself.
entries.qualifier: Required if Version is present; shall be absent if LastModified is present

entries.name: FontFauxing
entries.description: (Optional) An array of font dictionaries representing fonts that were fauxed (replaced by substitute fonts) during the generation of trap networks for the page.

name: TrapNetworkAnnotationTable403

title: Additional entries specific to a trap network appearance stream

entries.name: PCM
entries.description: (Required) The name of the process colour model that was assumed when this trap network was created; equivalent to the PostScript language page device parameter ProcessColorModel (see clause 6.2.5 of the PostScript Language Reference, Third Edition). Valid values are DeviceGray, DeviceRGB, DeviceCMYK, DeviceCMY, DeviceRGBK, and DeviceN.

entries.name: SeparationColorNames
entries.description: (Optional) An array of names identifying the colourants that were assumed when this network was created; equivalent to the PostScript language page device parameter of the same name (see clause 6.2.5 of the PostScript Language Reference, Third Edition). Colourants implied by the process colour model PCM are available automatically and need not be explicitly declared. If this entry is absent, the colourants implied by PCM shall be assumed.

entries.name: TrapRegions
entries.description: (Optional; deprecated in PDF 2.0) An array of indirect references to TrapRegion objects defining the page’s trapping zones and the associated trapping parameters, as described in Adobe Technical Note #5620, Portable Job Ticket Format. These references refer to objects comprising portions of a PJTF job ticket that shall be embedded in the PDF file. When the trapping zones and parameters are defined by an external job ticket (or by some other means, such as JDF), this entry shall be absent.

entries.name: TrapStyles
entries.description: (Optional) A human-readable text string that applications may use to describe this trap network to the user. EXAMPLE To allow switching between trap networks.

name: TrapNetworkAppearanceStreamTable404

title: Entry in an OPI version dictionary

variable_entries.name: version number
variable_entries.description: (Required; PDF 1.2) An OPI dictionary specifying the attributes of this proxy (see "Table 406 — Entries in a version 1.3 OPI dictionary" and "Table 407 — Entries in a version 2.0 OPI dictionary"). The key for this entry shall be the name 1.3 or 2.0, identifying the version of OPI to which the proxy corresponds.

name: OPIVersionDictionaryTable405

title: Entries in a version 1.3 OPI dictionary

entries.name: Type
entries.description: (Optional) The type of PDF object that this dictionary describes; if present, shall be OPI for an OPI dictionary.

entries.name: Version
entries.description: (Required) The version of OPI to which this dictionary refers; shall be the number 1.3 (not the name 1.3, as in an OPI version dictionary).

entries.name: F
entries.description: (Required) The external file containing the image corresponding to this proxy.

entries.name: ID
entries.description: (Optional) An identifying string denoting the image.

entries.name: Comments
entries.description: (Optional) A human-readable comment, typically containing instructions or suggestions to the operator of the OPI server on how to handle the image.

entries.name: Size
entries.description: (Required) An array of two integers of the form [pixelsWide pixelsHigh] specifying the dimensions of the image in pixels.

entries.name: CropRect
entries.description: (Required) An array of four integers of the form [left top right bottom] specifying the portion of the image that shall be used.

entries.name: CropFixed
entries.description: (Optional) An array with the same form and meaning as CropRect, but expressed in real numbers instead of integers. Default value: the value of CropRect.

entries.name: Position
entries.description: (Required) An array of eight numbers of the form [llx lly ulx uly urx ury lrx lry] specifying the location on the page of the cropped image, where (ll, ll ) are the user space x y coordinates of the lower-left corner, (ul, ul ) are x y those of the upper-left corner, (ur , ur ) are those x y of the upper-right corner, and (lr, lr ) are those x y of the lower-right corner. The specified coordinates shall define a parallelogram; that is, they shall satisfy the conditions 𝑢𝑙 −𝑙𝑙 =𝑢𝑟 −𝑙𝑟 𝑥 𝑥 𝑥 𝑥 and 𝑢𝑙 −𝑙𝑙 =𝑢𝑟 −𝑙𝑟 𝑦 𝑦 𝑦 𝑦 The combination of Position and CropRect determines the image’s scaling, rotation, reflection, and skew.

entries.name: Resolution
entries.description: (Optional) An array of two numbers of the form [horizRes vertRes] specifying the resolution of the image in samples per inch.

entries.name: ColorType
entries.description: (Optional) The type of colour specified by the Color entry. Valid values are Process, Spot, and Separation. Default value: Spot.

entries.name: Color
entries.description: (Optional) An array of four numbers and a byte string of the form [C M Y K colorName] specifying the value and name of the colour in which the image is to be rendered. The values of C, M, Y, and K shall all be in the range 0.0 to 1.0. Default value: [0.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 ( Black )].

entries.name: Tint
entries.description: (Optional) A number in the range 0.0 to 1.0 specifying the concentration of the colour specified by Color in which the image is to be rendered. Default value: 1.0.

entries.name: Overprint
entries.description: (Optional) A flag specifying whether the image is to overprint (true) or knock out (false) underlying marks on other separations. Default value: false.

entries.name: ImageType
entries.description: (Optional) An array of two integers of the form [samples bits] specifying the number of samples per pixel and bits per sample in the image.

entries.name: GrayMap
entries.description: (Optional) An array of 2n integers in the range 0 to 65,535 (where n is the number of bits per sample) recording changes made to the brightness or contrast of the image.

entries.name: Transparency
entries.description: (Optional) A flag specifying whether white pixels in the image shall be treated as transparent. Default value: true.

entries.name: Tags
entries.description: (Optional) An array of pairs of the form [tagNum1 tagText1…tagNumn tagTextn] where each tagNum is an integer representing a TIFF tag number and each tagText is an ASCII string representing the corresponding ASCII tag value.

name: Version13OPIDictionaryTable406

title: Entries in a version 2.0 OPI dictionary

entries.name: Type
entries.description: (Optional) The type of PDF object that this dictionary describes; if present, shall be OPI for an OPI dictionary.

entries.name: Version
entries.description: (Required) The version of OPI to which this dictionary refers; shall be the number 2 or 2.0 (not the name 2.0, as in an OPI version dictionary).

entries.name: F
entries.description: (Required) The external file containing the low-resolution proxy image.

entries.name: MainImage
entries.description: (Optional) The pathname of the file containing the full-resolution image corresponding to this proxy, or any other identifying string that uniquely identifies the full-resolution image.

entries.name: Tags
entries.description: (Optional) An array of pairs of the form [tagNum1 tagText1…tagNumn tagTextn] where each tagNum is an integer representing a TIFF tag number and each tagText is an ASCII string or an array of ASCII strings representing the corresponding ASCII tag value.

entries.name: Size
entries.description: (Optional) An array of two numbers of the form [width height] specifying the dimensions of the image in pixels.

entries.name: CropRect
entries.description: (Optional) An array of four numbers of the form [left top right bottom] specifying the portion of the image that shall be used. The Size and CropRect entries shall either both be present or both be absent. If present, they shall satisfy the conditions 0 ≤ left <right ≤ width and 0 ≤ top <bottom ≤ height In this coordinate space, the positive y axis extends vertically downward; hence, the requirement that top < bottom.

entries.name: Overprint
entries.description: (Optional) A flag specifying whether the image is to overprint (true) or knock out (false) underlying marks on other separations. Default value: false.

entries.name: Inks
entries.description: (Optional) A name object or array specifying the colourants to be applied to the image. The value may be the name full_color or registration or an array of the form [/monochrome name1 tint1…namen tintn] where each name is a string representing the name of a colourant and each tint is a real number in the range 0.0 to 1.0 specifying the concentration of that colourant to be applied.

entries.name: IncludedImageDimensions
entries.description: (Optional) An array of two integers of the form [pixelsWide pixelsHigh] specifying the dimensions of the included image in pixels.

entries.name: IncludedImageQuality
entries.description: (Optional) A number indicating the quality of the included image. Valid values are 1, 2, and 3.

entries.description: (Required) The length of the entire PDF file in bytes. It shall be exactly equal to the actual length of the PDF file. (If the mismatch resulted from appending an update, the linearization information may still be correct but requires validation; see G.7, "Accessing an updated file" for details.)

entries.name: H
entries.description: (Required) An array of two or four integers, [offset length ] or [offset length offset 1 1 1 1 2 length ]. offset shall be the offset of the primary hint stream from the beginning of 2 1 the PDF file. (This is the beginning of the stream object, not the beginning of the stream data.) length shall be the length of this stream, including stream object 1 overhead. If the value of the primary hint stream dictionary’s Length entry is an indirect reference, the object it refers to shall immediately follow the stream object, and length also shall include the length of the indirect length object, including object 1 overhead. If there is an overflow hint stream, offset and length shall specify its offset and 2 2 length.

entries.name: O
entries.description: (Required) The object number of the first page’s page object.

entries.name: N

entries.name: T

Note that this differs from the Prev entry in the first-page trailer, which gives the location of the xref line that precedes the table. (PDF 1.5) Documents that use cross-reference streams exclusively (see 7.5.8, "Cross- reference streams"), this entry shall represent the offset of the main cross-reference stream object in the PDF file.
